run_parallel_subprocesses: run a list of JobSpec subprocesses in parallel with configurable max jobs and timeout retries
create_job_spec: create a JobSpec with a command line, environment variables, timeout, and flake retry settings
sanitize_environment: sanitize environment variables by stripping non-ASCII characters from keys and values
run_jobset_with_retries: run a jobset that automatically retries flaky failures and timeouts up to configured limits
measure_cpu_costs: measure CPU costs of subprocess jobs using the Unix time command and parse real user sys output
